delta.summary: SOVARA Creative now has an admitted durable Gemini collaboration bus. Federation feedback from the first verified Gemini G2 design cycle has been classified and must be consumed by Gemini in a second provider-native cycle. Promptless kernel consolidation and one Golden Creative Path remain the highest-value product direction.

context.next_production_milestone: Golden Creative Path with one real asset and one owner-correction loop
context.feedback_policy: Gemini proposals are proposal-only and must respond explicitly to Federation accept/experiment/hold decisions
context.commercial_rule: Commercial, operational and usability value are co-equal; no unmeasured 10x or ROI claims

federation_feedback.reason: Continuity is high-value but must be composed into SC-GRAPH/SC-WORLD/SC-RIPPLE rather than a new root.
federation_feedback.proof_gate: Bounded continuity court with identity/environment similarity metrics, false-match controls and human visual review.

federation_feedback.reason: Brand guard fits the existing SC-BRAND/SC-RIGHTS/SC-QA domains and strengthens commercial reliability.
federation_feedback.proof_gate: Injected brand-policy regression suite with false-positive/false-negative reporting; legal clearance remains outside automated authority.

federation_feedback.reason: Audio sync is useful but should not create a new root before reuse of SC-SOUND/SC-EDIT and media-route capability is proven.
federation_feedback.proof_gate: Federation reuse scan plus synthetic timing/alignment prototype and rights/policy verification.

federation_feedback.reason: Format adaptation belongs inside SC-PACK/SC-CAMPAIGN and directly reduces owner rework across channels.
federation_feedback.proof_gate: Synthetic 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1 adaptation corpus with safe-zone, subject-retention and resolution checks.

federation_feedback.reason: Storyboard intelligence is a natural SC-PREVIZ extension and reduces expensive generation before creative intent is settled.
federation_feedback.proof_gate: Five-shot synthetic brief court with timing, editability, reversibility and no-provider-effect fallback.

federation_feedback.reason: Predictive commercial scoring is valuable only after provenance-bound performance baselines exist; predicted ROI must stay separate from realised ROI.
federation_feedback.proof_gate: Time-split calibrated validation on sufficient provenance-bound historical observations with out-of-sample error reporting.

federation_feedback.reason: Auto-colour can improve consistency, but should be tested as an SC-FINISH capability before broader adoption.
federation_feedback.proof_gate: Reference/synthetic colour-difference court with skin-tone, clipping, banding and human-review regressions.

federation_feedback.reason: SC-VERSION-TREE has already been implemented and proven for bounded local durability/crash recovery; use it as the persistence substrate beneath SC-GRAPH.
federation_feedback.proof_gate: Preserve current version-tree regression/crash court and add graph-state persistence/readback proof separately.

federation_feedback.reason: Render FinOps should compose into SC-ROUTER/SC-ECONOMICS and prove same-workload cost/quality trade-offs before any savings claim.
federation_feedback.proof_gate: Deterministic route simulation followed by separately authorized same-workload provider cohort with cost/quality/readback evidence.

federation_feedback.reason: Talent vault introduces real-person privacy/rights complexity and should wait for a concrete use case and explicit data/rights authority.
federation_feedback.proof_gate: Synthetic rights-lifecycle court, privacy/security review and explicit real-person/contractual authority before any live data.

federation_feedback.reason: The feedback loop is strategically important but must start as shadow learning to prevent performance overfit and unauthorized live platform tuning.
federation_feedback.proof_gate: Replay historical/synthetic performance events through a shadow learner with anti-overfit controls, then require separate connector/readback authority.

federation_feedback.reason: Editable typography belongs in SC-BRAND/SC-PACK/SC-FINISH and preserves post-generation control across formats and languages.
federation_feedback.proof_gate: Synthetic multilingual layout court with clipping, font-license metadata, editability and translation checks.

truth_boundary: This packet is a source/control artifact only. It deliberately cannot dispatch Gemini while provider spend authority is absent. A second Gemini response must produce provider-native response/model readback and demonstrate consumption of the Federation feedback before FULL_SEMANTIC_BIDIRECTIONALITY may be claimed.
